title: Colony and Terminal
author: Ada Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
